prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production sprite supplement atlas for the Hamilton pixel-billboard 3D game. Reference image 1 is the finished game's style/scale/character identity reference; DO NOT redraw that whole sheet. Reference image 2 is ONLY the existing citizen outfit/cap/apron/color design to translate to the same pixel style with a face. Output square 1536x1536 if possible, exactly 5 rows by 5 columns = 25 full-body isolated figures, even cells and generous clear magenta gutters between every row/column. Uniform solid magenta #ff00ff background, no shadows/background detail/text/gridlines/labels. Every figure has visible complete shoes and head in its cell. Crisp fine pixel-art outlines, palette, shading, chibi proportions and approx 3.5-head body size matching reference 1, equal adult height in ALL cells. Column directions SAME for every row: front, front-right 3/4, exact right profile, back-right 3/4, exact back. Adult citizen: warm medium-brown skin, friendly lined middle-aged male face, clean-shaven, plain cream linen work cap with rounded silhouette matching ref 2, slate blue-gray long coat and pale cuffs, cream waistcoat and cream neckcloth, long tan work apron to below knees, dark trousers and black shoes, no weapons. Loyalist is EXACT same young light-skinned brown ponytailed man as reference 1 ROW TWO: burgundy/red knee-length coat with gold buttons, cream waistcoat, cream breeches, ruffled white cravat, dark boots. Preserve his identity and outfit. ROW 1: citizen idle, relaxed arms down in all five directions. ROW 2: loyalist ARGUMENT POSE A, speaking emphatically, brow lowered, mouth clearly open, one arm bent outward at chest height with pointing hand indicating forward of his body; other hand at hip. ROW 3: loyalist ARGUMENT POSE B, same man, different strong debating gesture, forearm lifted with open palm and mouth open, other hand lowered near waist. ROW 4: citizen ARGUMENT POSE A, frowning and mouth open, both hands raised palms up in frustrated questioning. ROW 5: citizen ARGUMENT POSE B, same citizen, one arm extended outward and index finger pointing forward of body, other arm bent palm-up near chest, mouth open. Gestures should be very readable at tiny game scale and clearly distinct from stationary idle. Keep legs planted and body center aligned in every cell; no floating, no overlap across cells. These are expressive arguing characters, no fighting/weapons. The five row identities and poses and five column views are exact asset requirements.
